name: Bakini Noir Patisserie
description: A dark pastry theatre for a single bakery: a slim glass header, a carousel of the collections in arched windows, the collections as a side-scrolling lineup of tall dark cards, a bento of the shop's real facts (counter hours, delivery windows, pickup, shipping, cash on delivery), selection rows, a compare strip, deals and the journal; real spec filters, a product page with a sticky buy column and Buy together, a bag drawer, glass checkout cards, a desk account, and an ivory light mode.
